    // The number of OCCUPIED cells at the given cell size: a boolean fold over the
    // occupancy raster. Array3D<Boolean> inherits the flat IIndexable surface, so P2's
    // Reduce reaches every cell by flat index; the accumulator counts the true cells.
    VoxelOccupiedCount(self: IVoxel3D, cellSize: Number): Integer
        => self.ToOccupancyGrid(cellSize).Occupied.Reduce(0, (acc, b) => b ? acc + 1 : acc);
